copy_gaps: The price pill reads 64,011.5: E11-D02 L300 gives the pointer's price at tick precision (E11-D01 O4, the footprint readout unit, is open) and the spec gives no pointer price; the board rests the pointer mid-level on 64,011.0 (§4.7 L328's cell), so the value is derived from the pointer's position, not data.

E11-D02 §7.3's other rows (the title 'date time · interval', O H L C, Vol · Δ, the indicator rows and the overflow row; E11-D02 L308-314) are not drawn. §4.7 L324-325 makes the tooltip E11-D02's box with the footprint rows in place of its ▪ cell row, so in the app its title and O H L C / Vol · Δ rows (L308-311) sit above them; but the spec gives no 13:35 date, open, high or low (Vol 887 and Δ +491 follow from §4.1's five levels, L220-224), so the frame draws §4.7's rows alone, as its sketch does (L327-331), and block-01 says so. PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): §4.7 L324-325 either gives 13:35's title and O H L C values, or states that the footprint rows stand alone.

Width: E11-D02 L318 bounds the compact box at 200–260 px (≤ 40 % of the pane width); §4.7's rows on one line (L328-330) need about 392.2 px at type.num.sm (the 57-character second row). The rows are this spec's (§4.7 L328-330, D14 L164), so whether they wrap or the box widens is its to state: drawn on one line as §4.7 draws them, within 40 % of the 1,208 px plot (483 px). PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): §4.7 states whether its rows wrap or the box widens (an A-row to E11-D02 L318).

The full label's place when the bracket's top end has no free space is not stated (§4.4 L290-293 place the short label only; OQ-5 L924: the full label ≈ 230 px): right of the newest bar's bracket the plot's edge leaves 18 px, so it is drawn on the untraded 64,014.0 row above the high (§4.4 L291's free row), left of 13:35 (plot x 839-1069, y 0.5-13.5), where it covers no cell, wick, body, ledge or cap; the engine rule is E18-S08's (#632).

D7 (L157) puts the word 'forming' in the legend, but §4.9 L380-382's legend row (and §4.1 L218's sketch) carries none: the legend reads 'FP Bid × Ask · rows 10 ticks · BTC' (as boards 05, 06); for E18-D05's copy deck to settle.

The pressed cluster segment reads 'Live' in E11-D02 §7.2 (L267; the word is owner question O-E, 'Live' or 'Following'), while §4.1's sketch writes 'auto' (L227): the board keeps 'auto' with the check glyph.

Price-gutter labels (63,975.0-64,010.0, every 5 rows at E11-D02's 40 px gap) and the bar times (12:55-13:30, 5m) are derived from the window and the interval: the spec writes only 64,009.0-64,013.0 and 13:25 / 13:30 / 13:35 (§4.1 L220-227).
